run_inversion_optimization: run the StyleNeRF inversion optimization to project a target image into latent space
run_main_with_options: run main with network pickle, target image, output directory, and optimization steps
calculate_loss: calculate MSE and perceptual loss between synthesized and target images using VGG16 features
create_vgg16_perceptual: create a VGG16_for_Perceptual module that extracts multi-layer features from input images
optimize_latent_codes: optimize latent W codes and camera matrices to match a target image using Adam optimizer
